text:
jamal: Heads-up — my flight's delayed, I need someone to take primary for the overnight window (00:00-08:00 PT). I'm on pager for the next 30m but won't be reliable after that.
maria: I can cover 00:00-04:00 PT but have a hard stop at 04:00. Do we have a secondary for the 04:00-08:00 slot? @alex?
alex: I can pick up 04:00-08:00 PT, happy to take the handoff. Quick Q: any active incidents I should be aware of before the swap?
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Incident #1987 still open — increased 5xx on embed-service (us-west-2). Current mitigation: rate-limit toggle + canary fallback. Pager still active.
jamal: Thanks — incident is stabilized, mitigation in place. Before I hand over I'll dump the quick state: KV cache warm, no rolling deploys in flight, batch windows off between 23:30-01:30 PT. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-5xx
maria: OK I see the runbook. I'll run through the handoff checklist now.
jamal: Hand-off checklist (copying to avoid typos):
```
- confirm pager routed to new primary
- share recent alert graph (last 30m)
- ensure KV cache warm (approx 60k keys)
- note active mitigations and rollback flags
- list any scheduled jobs (none for next 8h)
```

maria: Doing `curl https://oncall.redwood/api/assign?user=maria&role=primary` — should be instant. Will post confirmation.
ops-bot: @maria assigned primary for 00:00-04:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
alex: I'll stand by for 03:50 PT to sync state with @maria. Assuming the incident remains quiet, I'll accept primary at 04:00.
tessa: Heads-up — if the embed incident flares, we should consider enabling `fallback-embed-v1` routing (pre-tested). I left the command in #eng-runtime pinned messages.
maria: Confirmed pager routing and alert link posted: https://metrics.redwood/graphs/embed-5xx?range=30m. KV cache: warmed to ~62k keys (ran `kv-check --summary`). Leaving a short note in the oncall doc.
alex: Got it. I'll take 04:00-08:00 PT. @jamal safe travels — thanks for the heads up. I'll monitor the incident for the first 30m and escalate if error rate rises above 2%.
jamal: Thanks everyone. Quick extra: if you need to toggle the rate-limit, it's `rbac toggle rl/embed-service --percent 30` (runbook step 4). I also left the temporary rollback flag key: `deploy.embed.rollback=staging-2026-03-15` in the incident channel.
ops-bot: Reminder: please update the rotation doc after swap: https://docs.redwood/oncall/rotation. Use the `--handoff-note` flag if you want the automation to annotate the schedule.
alex: Will update after 04:05 PT. Good to go from me.
maria: Handoff complete from my side at 00:01 PT — left note: "overnight primswap due to travel; incident #1987 monitored". :thumbsup:
jamal: Appreciate it — closing my active watch and setting OOO on calendar. Ping me if anything spikes.
